text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that parking be prohibited at all times on the north side of Grace Street, between Cedar Brae Boulevard and Greenwich Square. The proposed parking prohibition is to address concerns from residents in the subject area with respect to parked vehicles causing sight-line obstructions and safety hazards.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Grace Street, between Cedar Brae Boulevard and Greenwich Square.
